title: DocumentUploadMetadata

sourceUri.description: Where the document came from (URL or path), if known.

contentType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file, for example `text/markdown` or `application/pdf`.

users.description: User ids that may read the document.

groups.description: Group ids whose members may read the document.

wholeTenant.description: When true, every user in the caller's tenant may read the document.

description: Metadata sent with a document upload, as the `metadata` part of the multipart request.
